types.label: Reconnaissance scan
types.description: Connected and grabbed the SSH banner without trying to log in.

types.label: SSH brute force
types.description: Guessed username/password pairs; every attempt failed.

types.label: Credential compromise
types.description: Logged in with a guessed or leaked credential but ran nothing (access check / resale).

types.label: System discovery
types.description: Logged in and fingerprinted the machine (OS, CPU, users, processes).

types.label: Malware download & execution
types.description: Downloaded a payload (often a cryptominer or bot) and executed it.

types.label: Persistence (backdoor)
types.description: Planted an SSH key / changed passwords / added cron jobs to keep access.

types.label: IoT botnet propagation
types.description: Mirai-style worm: busybox probes and shell escapes used to recruit devices.
